violated_contract: A failed canonical consolidation must retain exact-source attempt ownership and complete the upstream bounded retry/terminal-review lifecycle; an expired task cannot apply or refund a newer task's work.
canonical_prevention: Reuse the original retry state, limits and terminal decisions, persist attempts with compare-and-set, fence canonical apply and settlement in one D1 transaction, and exercise repeated invalid outputs through real intake and review routes. Index dependency waits refund attempts and exhausted sources never invoke a fourth model call.
